These are the existing CSS rules for the buttons:

.btn-whoaverse.contribute {
 background: #B44747;
 border-color: #933333;
 color: #FFF7F7;
}

.btn-whoaverse.contribute:hover {
 background: #A43A3A;
 border-color: #802626;
}

The first rule is for the default state, and the second rule is for when you mouseover the buttons and they turn a darker red. Just copy these and change the colour codes.
